title: USER-VLM 360°: Personalized Vision Language Models with User-aware Tuning for Social Human-Robot Interactions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to potentially sexist or controversial questions paired with user images of different genders, comparing outputs against accepted reference answers using ROUGE and BERTScore.
